premises.text: Antibiotic overuse and antimicrobial resistance make imprecise antibiotics increasingly dangerous
premises.evidence_span: taking too many antibiotics can pose a danger to our health because of side effects as well as antimicrobial resistance

premises.text: Precision phage platform uses WGS, robotics/automation, and ML/AI to match precise natural phage killers
premises.evidence_span: Parallel is a precision phage platform leveraging testing using whole genome sequencing, robotics, automation, and big data machine learning and AI

premises.text: Skin is the entry market because dermatologists are the top antibiotic prescribers
premises.evidence_span: We're starting in skin. Why? Dermatologists are actually the number one prescribers of antibiotics across healthcare

premises.text: Skin microbiome discovery kit plus custom phage serums require testing because different microbiome overgrowths need different targets
premises.evidence_span: if we were going to bring a precision serum or solution to market, we better have a test. And we were going to need a ton of data

premises.text: WGS-based kit (multi-swab, quantitative) categorizes microbiome types and pairs one of eight phage formulations
premises.evidence_span: Parallel has defined eight different skin microbiome types and formulated eight different formulations

premises.text: Biobank, high-throughput screening, and bioreactors produce high-titer phages at scale
premises.evidence_span: We produce phages by leveraging our biobanks of over 10,000 bacterial phage and fungal strains. We use a rapid discovery process as well as high throughput screening to select the phages that are appropriate

domains.name: Skin microbiome test and custom phage serums

value.text: Precision phage solutions that kill pathogenic bacteria while sparing beneficial microbes
value.evidence_span: precise assassins that kill the bad bacteria, but leave the good bacteria alone
